verdict.rationale: Recurly's docs show hybrid subscription-plus-usage pricing through usage-based add-ons on plans, with measured units tracked across plans and billed at the end of each cycle. They also show per-unit quantity adjustments and credits (credit invoices, and credits on subscription changes). The pack does not evidence tiered, volume, or graduated pricing schemes, minimum commitments, or overage billing. Missing for 10: tiered/volume/graduated pricing models, commitments/minimums, overage handling, explicit no-code configuration evidence, independent corroboration.
